Class NumberBox

java.lang.Object
javafx.scene.Node
javafx.scene.Parent
javafx.scene.layout.Region
javafx.scene.layout.Pane
javafx.scene.layout.HBox
net.tessel.fx.components.NumberBox
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.css.Styleable, javafx.event.EventTarget
public class NumberBox extends javafx.scene.layout.HBox
Number input with step buttons, a range, and arithmetic: type 12 * 3 + 4 and press Enter. 
NumberBox quantity = new NumberBox(1, 0, 99);
quantity.setSuffix(" pcs");
quantity.valueProperty().addListener((o, was, is) -> ...);
The value is committed on Enter, on focus loss and when stepped (arrow keys, Page Up / Down, the mouse wheel and the buttons). It is clamped to the range, can wrap around (setWrapEnabled(boolean)), and can be empty (setNullable(boolean), the value is then NaN). Text that cannot be evaluated flashes red and the old value is restored.
